0022600121.text: The Celtics come into this home game at 1-1, with a 1-0 mark at home and a win in their most recent game, sitting 7th in the East and 3rd in the Atlantic, 1.5 games back. The Bulls are 1-2, have lost their last game, and sit 10th in the East and 4th in the Central, also 1.5 games back. Boston will be without Devin Carter (illness), while Chicago will be missing Nic Claxton (hamstring), and Noa Essengue and Patrick Williams are listed as day-to-day with game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, but Boston won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 124-105 home win over Chicago on February 11, 2026.
